recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is recommended for FHIR-42886 unless a future build identifies a generated artifact derived from the pre-fix example.
issue_request: FHIR-42886 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for R6, replacing EvidenceVariable.characteristic with EvidenceVariable.definition 0..1 CodeableReference, allowing definition.concept with an example binding, limiting definition.reference to Group, and removing characteristic rather than deprecating it.
initial_application: Git commit b6ffbe50c67dfcc7f9ceac3463e582537ad2d85c applied the main change by removing EvidenceVariable.characteristic from the StructureDefinition, adding EvidenceVariable.definition, updating the introduction, and removing or converting most examples. Later commits dc839c2165367b960e9f166b1a5429002e43489c and 6ac79742bb62f4e97b76ad6cea017dc197cb3bc7 restored converted examples, but source/evidencevariable/evidencevariable-example.xml remained in the old direct characteristic shape.
additional_context: EvidenceVariable is an active core resource in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition already defines EvidenceVariable.definition as CodeableReference(Group), and the introduction describes definition as a concept or Group reference. source/fhir.ini references to EvidenceVariable.characteristic are in the [r4-r6-changes] and [r5-r6-changes] migration/change-map sections, where removed old paths are expected. Zulip search found no conflicting discussion; a CDS/HEvKA Confluence summary confirms the work group changed the request from deprecation to removal.
reconciliation: Changed source/evidencevariable/evidencevariable-example.xml so the example preserves its original 'Diabetic patients over 65' CodeableConcept text under definition.concept instead of the removed characteristic.definitionCodeableConcept.
source_changes: source/evidencevariable/evidencevariable-example.xml: replaced direct EvidenceVariable.characteristic/definitionCodeableConcept with EvidenceVariable.definition/concept while preserving the concept text.
